_note: The family-pension deduction (D-196; rulebook OS-FAMPEN-001, -002): "for income in the nature of family pension (a regular monthly amount payable by the employer to a family member of an employee upon the death of such employee),–– (i) an amount equal to one-third of such income or ₹ 25000, whichever is less, where income-tax is computed under section 202(1); and (ii) an amount equal to one-third of such income or ₹ 15000, whichever is less, in any other case" (S2 s.93(1)(d), p.141). TY 2025-26: Income-tax Act, 1961 s.57(iia) "a deduction of a sum equal to thirty-three and one-third per cent of such income or fifteen thousand rupees, whichever is less" (thc p.310) — the same fraction, held as the divisor 3 (FamilyPensionShare) so neither year rounds a percentage — and the proviso of F(No.2)A 2024 s.24(b): where tax is computed under s.115BAC(1A)(ii), "twenty-five thousand rupees" for "fifteen thousand rupees" (egazette 2024/256436 p.24, w.e.f. 1-4-2025). The family pensions excluded from total income (S2 Schedule III Sl. 15, 16; 1961 s.10(18)(ii), (19)) are not entered (OtherSourceKind.FAMILY_PENSION). This row is the "any other case" limb, outside the new regime; OS-FAMILY-PENSION-NEW-TAX-REGIME is the other.
